note: Set B preserves the specification conditions more faithfully (8D ring-shank nail @ 6" O.C. each side, lag screw with washer, plate holes typical, sealant each side as recommended by manufacturer) and adds real facts A misses (lag screw, sealant, 7/16" plate holes, grade level 0"), with verbatim quotes. Set A duplicates the frame/joist/hex-bolt claims three times each, misreads the callout number as "8 8D", and fabricates or truncates quotes ("3/4" = 1'-0" TYP.", "OUGH BOLT", "Detail A3: 3/4" = 1'-0" DECK MODULE TO CONNECTION"), while misbinding 8'-0" and 1'-4" to the A3 connection. B's main errors are misbinding the 1'-4 3/4" / 1'-4" / 1'-3 1/4" segment dimensions (A1 typ. deck module) to RAILING ATTACHMENT, calling 8'-0" a "deck connection spacing", and an unsupported scaffold-footing-to-frame connection plus two trivial tautological claims. B also omits the joist, steel decking and waterproofing membrane, but on balance its correct claims are more numerous and better bound.
